pride_data.title: BioID of PAX8 in human ovarian cancer cells
pride_data.projectDescription: Investigation of interactors for the human transcription factor PAX8 using BioID-based proximity labeling, as described in Galli et al.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: A PAX8-BioID construct was introduced in the endogenous PAX8 locus of IGROV-1 cells using CRISPR. Biotinylated proteins were purified with Streptavidin and analysed by quantitative mass spectrometry using TMT labeling.
